title: WikiSQE: A Large-Scale Dataset for Sentence Quality Estimation in Wikipedia

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the ability of language models (DeBERTa, BERT, RoBERTa, and GPT-4) to automatically detect Wikipedia sentences annotated by human editors with the 'Neutrality disputed' or 'Undue weight' inline templates, which indicate subjective, non-neutral, or biased encyclopedic statements.
